insert_sample.postgres: INSERT INTO synapse_fluid_dynamics (collected_at, scenario_name, intersection_id, edge_id, density, mean_speed, min_speed, queue_length, max_queue, occupancy, edge_length, num_lanes, speed_limit, maturity_stage) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s);
insert_sample.sqlite: INSERT INTO synapse_fluid_dynamics (collected_at, scenario_name, intersection_id, edge_id, density, mean_speed, min_speed, queue_length, max_queue, occupancy, edge_length, num_lanes, speed_limit, maturity_stage) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?);

query_history.postgres: SELECT edge_id, density, mean_speed, queue_length, occupancy, edge_length, num_lanes, speed_limit, collected_at, maturity_stage, scenario_name, intersection_id, min_speed, max_queue FROM synapse_fluid_dynamics WHERE collected_at >= %s;
query_history.sqlite: SELECT edge_id, density, mean_speed, queue_length, occupancy, edge_length, num_lanes, speed_limit, collected_at, maturity_stage, scenario_name, intersection_id, min_speed, max_queue FROM synapse_fluid_dynamics WHERE collected_at >= ?;
query_history.all: SELECT edge_id, density, mean_speed, queue_length, occupancy, edge_length, num_lanes, speed_limit, collected_at, maturity_stage, scenario_name, intersection_id, min_speed, max_queue FROM synapse_fluid_dynamics;

query_aggregated.postgres: SELECT edge_id, SUM(density * (mean_speed * 3.6)) AS volume_sum, COUNT(*) AS volume_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN mean_speed > 0.1 THEN GREATEST(0.0, (edge_length / mean_speed) - (edge_length / COALESCE(NULLIF(speed_limit, 0), 13.89))) ELSE 0.0 END) AS delay_sum, COUNT(CASE WHEN mean_speed > 0.1 THEN 1 END) AS delay_cnt, AVG(queue_length) AS avg_queue, MAX(queue_length) AS max_queue, MAX(edge_length) AS edge_length, MAX(num_lanes) AS num_lanes, MAX(speed_limit) AS speed_limit, COUNT(*) AS total_samples FROM synapse_fluid_dynamics WHERE collected_at >= %s GROUP BY edge_id;
query_aggregated.sqlite: SELECT edge_id, SUM(density * (mean_speed * 3.6)) AS volume_sum, COUNT(*) AS volume_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN mean_speed > 0.1 THEN MAX(0.0, (edge_length / mean_speed) - (edge_length / COALESCE(NULLIF(speed_limit, 0), 13.89))) ELSE 0.0 END) AS delay_sum, COUNT(CASE WHEN mean_speed > 0.1 THEN 1 END) AS delay_cnt, AVG(queue_length) AS avg_queue, MAX(queue_length) AS max_queue, MAX(edge_length) AS edge_length, MAX(num_lanes) AS num_lanes, MAX(speed_limit) AS speed_limit, COUNT(*) AS total_samples FROM synapse_fluid_dynamics WHERE collected_at >= ? GROUP BY edge_id;
